_comment: Private grading fixture. Records lie inside the disclosed parameter and phase-seed envelope and satisfy the disclosed suite-composition policy. The structural model, generator, phase-seed convention, metrics, targets, moat, curves, weights, and exponent are all public; only these six fixed tuples are private. The score is the worst case over all six records.

scoring.calibration_note: Targets are set just above the achievable worst-case performance of a balanced isolation design evaluated at the disclosed maximum-considered ground motion (the long-period, high-intensity corner). A design optimized only against the milder public probe records (pga 0.28) under-controls isolator displacement at the MCE corner and is gated by the moat; an over-stiff/over-strong design loses acceleration and drift credit. The moat gate is a distinct hard-capacity (pounding) limit state from the displacement serviceability target.
